hooks.name: menu_input_closed
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's InventoryCloseEvent with the inventory's contents)

rust_summary: server menus with input slots the player fills as a chest's (`native_open_menu_with_input`), what such a menu holds (`native_menu_contents`), the cursor of a click (`native_menu_cursor`) and the input slots when it closes (`native_menu_input_closed`).
doc_summary: `native_open_menu_with_input(uuid, rows, title, items, input)` opens a server menu whose slots in `input` take and give items by vanilla's click rules, the rest shown by the mod as in `native_open_menu`; `native_menu_contents(uuid)` reads what an open server menu holds, `native_menu_cursor(uuid)` the stack on the player's cursor (inside `native_menu_clicked`, the one of that click), and `native_menu_input_closed(uuid, window, slots)` hears the input slots as the menu closes: what the mods leave goes back to the player as vanilla's `clearContainer` does. Bundles need "hooks": @API:menu_input@.
